cumulative_usage.scope: Previous pilot ledgers, including incomplete attempts, plus every native attempt in this iteration. Current iteration limits apply only to its own ledger.

ownership_limit: Structural ownership is not semantic entailment; auxiliary refs never receive answer-credit from this audit.

checkpoint_evidence.scope: Bounded diagnostic receipts only. Authoritative final usage comes exclusively from native ledger finishes; checkpoints never fill unknown totals.

pipeline_failure_scope: Canonical list has its frozen aggregation scope; an empty list does not imply no generation job rejection or native failure. Native failed/unknown attempts remain independently counted; driver journal and diagnosis are separate provenance.
token_cap_compliance: Current native-token cap can be checked from reported usage.
limits: Any failed call usage or actual native profile absent from receipts remains unknown, not zero.
Hypothetical API scenarios cover reported known usage only and exclude the failed call’s unknown usage; they are not complete total costs or actual billing.
Partial grades are descriptive observations under full denominators, not a completed quality outcome.
Mechanical identity/schema/recount only; no new model judgments, grade repair, reruns, Store mutation, source edits or network.
Incomplete slots and failed calls remain explicit; integrity success never asserts quality success.
Disclosed controls and post-sealing exposure limitations remain attached; actual billing is unknown.
Pattern scans cannot prove absence of every possible sensitive string.
